decision.rationale: I'm declining this dispute. The time limit is met: TXN-007940 posted on 2026-07-29 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, which is 87 days later and within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The card shows two purchases at BRIGHTWATER GROCERS (MER-000037) for 5329 EUR cents (53.29 EUR) each. TXN-007939 was made on 2026-07-27 at 17:06 and posted on 2026-07-28 under AUTH-008144, a chip payment with the PIN verified, approved with no fraud flag. The disputed TXN-007940 was made on 2026-07-28 at 01:06 and posted on 2026-07-29 under AUTH-008145, a contactless payment, approved with no fraud flag. The two postings do not share an authorisation. Each has its own, and they were made about 8 hours apart. There is no refund on the card. Under duplicate-separate-authorisations, these are two separate purchases, not one purchase posted twice, so the duplicate-charge claim is declined. If the cardholder did not make the second payment, that would be a separate unauthorised-transaction claim and is not decided here.

proposed_actions.reason: The two 53.29 EUR charges at BRIGHTWATER GROCERS were approved separately, on 27 July at 17:06 and on 28 July at 01:06, about 8 hours apart. They are two separate purchases, not one purchase charged twice. If you did not make one of these payments, please open a dispute for an unauthorised payment instead.
